items.title: 27.4.4 Nutritional and Biological Importance of Lipids

source_refs.note: Topic 27.4.4 with the hibernation box and the second Quick Check 27.3 (the book repeats the number), answered (PDF 171-172). Answers need review.

items: A major function of lipids is to be the main store of energy in living organisms. They give more energy per gram than carbohydrates, because they release more heat when oxidised to carbon dioxide and water.
Lipids act as solvents for the fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E and K and help their absorption in the intestine and transport in the blood; these vitamins should be eaten with a little healthy fat.
Fats insulate the body against heat loss, because they are non-polar. (The book also mentions insulation from water and electricity.)

blocks.title: Did you know? Hibernation
blocks.text: Animals such as polar bears, reptiles and amphibians store extra fat before hibernating. During hibernation they greatly slow their metabolic rate, body temperature, heart rate and breathing to save energy when food is scarce. Fat is a more concentrated energy source than glycogen, so they can use stored fat efficiently while using very little energy.

blocks.prompt: Why are lipids not soluble in water?
blocks.explanation: Their long hydrocarbon chains are non-polar (hydrophobic) and cannot form hydrogen bonds with water molecules.

blocks.prompt: Give three major functions of lipids in the human body.
blocks.explanation: Any three: energy storage; insulation and protection of organs; structural part of cell membranes (phospholipids); solvent for fat-soluble vitamins; hormones (steroids).

blocks.prompt: Which lipids do or do not contain fatty acids? Give examples.
blocks.explanation: Containing fatty acids: triglycerides (fats and oils), waxes and phospholipids. Not containing fatty acids: steroids (cholesterol) and terpenes (limonene).

blocks.prompt: Vegetable oil and vegetable ghee are both triglycerides. What is the major structural difference?
blocks.explanation: Vegetable oil contains mainly unsaturated fatty acids (C=C), so it is liquid; vegetable ghee is made by hydrogenating oil, so its fatty acids are mostly saturated and it is solid.

items: Lipids: richest energy store; carry vitamins A, D, E, K; insulate.
Hibernating animals rely on stored fat.
